candidates.name: Stumbaugh & Associates, Inc.
candidates.base_city: Burbank (offices also in San Diego and West Sacramento)
candidates.partition_evidence: Website offers professional installation of bathroom partitions; a May 2023 Construction In Focus article describes it as a Division 10 subcontractor that sells partitions to GCs with installation by its own union crews.
red_flags: No Fresno office on its own website or contact page; the 2023 article contradicts itself (researching Fresno vs 'definitely opened up a Fresno office')
Sells partitions itself (distributor): buy-around risk
Nearest listed office is West Sacramento, about 170 miles away
candidates.reason: Clearly installs commercial restroom partitions statewide, but no verified office within 30 miles of Fresno and it is a competing partition distributor. Worth asking whether it covers Fresno.
